joonpark.en: LLMs can encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟；下一个前沿是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; safety requires defense in depth.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AGI 可能是专业智能体的分布式社会，而非单一实体；安全需要纵深防御。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; value lies in counterfactual shaping.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟模型应代表人类价值和偏见，而非超理性智能；价值在于反事实塑造。

tworek.en: Reasoning via chain of thought, with pre-training plus RL as core formula; RLHF crucial for GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，强调思维链推理，预训练加强化学习是核心公式；RLHF 对 GPT-4 的实用性至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models, but self-correction and continual learning are missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，认为扩展预训练和强化学习可提升模型，但自我纠正和持续学习是 AGI 缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning; architecture, not scaling, is the key bottleneck; RL is inefficient.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，认为 Transformer 限制持续学习，架构而非规模是主要瓶颈，强化学习效率不足。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not replace them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with expert data is the limiting factor; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他强调数据是新代码而非石油，后训练中的专家数据是限制因素，AI 将成为最大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; product design is the biggest blocker for agents.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他聚焦于后训练与专门数据的重要性，认为合成数据并非万能，产品设计是智能体的最大障碍。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is the raw material; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces are necessary.
awang.zh: 2025 年，他转向 AI 的集中化风险，强调数据是原材料，人类需保持主权，并认为脑机接口是必要的。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is the new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence is near; safety and selective open-sourcing are critical.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他提出递归自我改进的新范式，智能体开始工作，超级智能临近，安全与选择性开源至关重要。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x; first principles thinking is essential for breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全快速复用是航天圣杯，可将入轨成本降低百倍；第一性原理思维是突破性工程的关键。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观裁判，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; AI safety hinges on truth-seeking, not political correctness; population collapse is civilization's greatest threat.
elon.zh: 2024 年，Neuralink 首例植入具有历史意义；AI 安全取决于追求真理而非政治正确；人口崩溃是文明最大威胁。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next; AI annihilation probability is 10-20%.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他认为我们处于智能大爆炸初期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来；AI 毁灭人类的概率为 10-20%。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence combined by 2030; space-based AI data centers will be the cheapest and most scalable option within 36 months.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能总和；太空 AI 数据中心将在 36 个月内成为最便宜且可扩展的选择。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning enable unlimited data via next-token prediction.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步核心，Transformer 与自监督学习通过下一个词预测提供无限数据。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction; inference is now 90% of data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他提出预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非被动下一个词预测；推理已占数据中心 90%功耗，需专用硬件。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; agents run for days on decomposed tasks; context engineering and specialized inference hardware are key.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已达初级工程师编码水平，智能体可运行数天处理分解任务，上下文工程与专用推理硬件是关键。

jeffdean.en: Most model limitations are energy and data-IO bottlenecks; data movement costs 1000x more than compute; useful AI from unreliable components.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他反共识地指出多数模型限制源于能耗与数据 IO 瓶颈，数据移动比算力贵千倍，可用不可靠组件构建 AI。

jeffdean.en: Future scarce skill is taste, not coding; startups should target problems where frontier models fail, not where they partly work.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他预测未来稀缺技能是品味而非编码，创业应瞄准前沿模型完全失败的问题，而非部分可行的领域。

mengto.en: AI enables solo builders to create tools; designers must craft their own AI-driven workflows to avoid becoming AI slop.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，他认为 AI 让个人能自建工具，设计师必须打造自己的 AI 工作流，避免沦为 AI 生成的同质化内容。

mengto.en: Powerful models need giant prompts with context and design systems; AI is not inherently smarter without precise guidance.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，他强调强大模型需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词；没有精确引导，AI 不会自动变聪明。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity; start before ready, ship imperfect work, and focus on one painful problem for few clients.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 是人生最大的技术机遇，主张在未准备好时就开始、发布不完美的作品，并聚焦少数客户的一个痛点问题。

mengto.en: Perfectionism and overthinking hinder progress; launch at 80% and iterate, while avoiding venture capital by funding with clients.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他批判完美主义和过度思考，建议以 80% 完成度发布并迭代，同时反对风投，主张用客户收入自筹资金。

mengto.en: Consistently values action over planning, modeling success, and giving first; evolves from tool-building to broader entrepreneurial advice.
mengto.zh: 从 2026 年 6 月到 7 月，他始终重视行动胜过规划、模仿成功者、先给予后索取；观点从工具构建扩展到更广泛的创业建议。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负荷；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; iterative deployment helps society adapt; alignment linked to capability.
altman.zh: 2023 年，指出 RLHF 用少量数据即可对齐模型，迭代部署让社会适应，对齐与能力紧密相关。

altman.en: Compute is most precious; governance crucial; safety is whole-company effort; iterative deployment reduces surprise.
altman.zh: 2024 年，强调算力最宝贵，治理至关重要，安全是全公司责任，迭代部署减少意外。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core principle.
altman.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是渐变过程，超级智能意味着自主发现，算力是瓶颈，隐私是核心原则。

altman.en: Prediction close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential.
altman.zh: 2026 年，提出预测接近智能，下一个词预测能发现新知识，发展个人 AGI，机器人技术不可或缺。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still in crawl phase for most Google products; coding agents are most mature, other verticals will follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 在谷歌多数产品中仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，其他垂直领域将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们所说的模型现在包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model that blurs the line between video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，Omni 是一个统一的世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI 更具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, leading to even more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来更多而非更少的机会。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them, especially in healthcare.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强人类而非取代，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable embodied AI and robotics.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为超越 Scaling，AI 需要创造力、抽象和情商；世界模型推动具身 AI 和机器人。

feifei.en: AI augments human capabilities, not automates intelligence; agency and adaptation are key in the AI era.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 增强而非自动化智能；在 AI 时代，主动性和适应能力是关键。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and evaluation; robots should specialize in narrow tasks.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出模拟对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据生成和评估；机器人应专精于窄任务。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months from now, not today.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; engineers become builders; productivity up 200%.
boris.zh: 编码几乎已被解决；工程师转变为构建者；生产力提升 200%。

boris.en: AI agents like Claude Code drive exponential growth; non-engineers adopt coding.
boris.zh: 像 Claude Code 这样的智能体驱动指数级增长；非工程师开始采用编码。

boris.en: Loops are the next abstraction; ROI framing; coding on phone with 8B tokens.
boris.zh: 循环是下一个抽象层；ROI 框架；用 80 亿 token 在手机上编码。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory; delete system prompts; models self-improve.
boris.zh: 具有记忆的主动式 AI；删除系统提示；模型自我改进。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not just preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐不仅防止危害，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter enables Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of cost, challenging the assumption that better models cost more.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数让用户以更低成本获得 Opus 级智能，挑战了“更强模型必然更贵”的假设。

diannepenn.en: Coding became a key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drove adoption, shifting focus from writing to agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码成为关键差异化优势，Claude Code 和 Opus 4.5 推动采用，焦点从写作转向智能体能力。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product management tools, enabling test-driven development for AI products.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具，实现 AI 产品的测试驱动开发。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha, emphasizing long-running agent tasks over short interactions.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗是面向未来并获取超额收益，强调长时运行的智能体任务而非短交互。

jensen.en: At the start of hyper Moore's law, scaling doubles or triples performance yearly; data centers are token factories.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋提出超摩尔定律的开端，规模扩张使性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心成为生产智能代币的工厂。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute will surge a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，黄仁勋指出存在三种缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将激增十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x compute; agents will dominate the future internet.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，黄仁勋强调 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步算力需求增长百倍；智能体将主导未来互联网。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the foundational bottleneck.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋提出 AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型和应用；能源是基础性瓶颈。

jensen.en: AI augments jobs, not eliminates them; radiologists and coders are more needed; everyone becomes a programmer via natural language.
jensen.zh: 黄仁勋始终认为 AI 增强而非消除工作；放射科医生和程序员需求增加；自然语言让每个人都能编程。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding. Physical AI's impact in farming, mining, construction within 5-10 years.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足，减少苦难；恐惧源于误解。物理 AI 将在 5-10 年内影响农业、矿业和建筑业。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving core value is saving lives; Transformers enable generalized physical AI. Horizontal platform beats vertical integration; hardest part is diffusion.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是拯救生命；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI。横向平台优于垂直整合；最难的是扩散。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI. End-to-end RL scales better than imitation; world models evolve to neural simulation; tools democratize autonomy.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI。端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具扩展性；世界模型向神经模拟演进；工具使自主性民主化。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market. Speed enables new business models.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要，慢 AI 没有市场；速度催生新商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper than slow ones; CUDA's importance declines.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，快 token 比慢 token 更便宜；CUDA 重要性下降。

feldman.en: Inference speed per user is the dominant metric; wafer-scale SRAM cuts weight-moving time, making GPUs fundamentally slow.
feldman.zh: 每用户推理速度成为主导指标；晶圆级 SRAM 减少权重移动时间，GPU 本质缓慢。

feldman.en: Hardcoding model architectures into chips is a mistake; accelerate sparse linear algebra instead. Reasoning models amplify speed advantage.
feldman.zh: 将模型架构硬编码进芯片是错误；应加速稀疏线性代数。推理模型放大速度优势。

feldman.en: Consistently: AI demand outstrips supply; data center capacity is the main constraint; open-source models are cheaper and close in capability.
feldman.zh: 始终：AI 需求超供给；数据中心容量是主要约束；开源模型更便宜且能力接近。

hasani.en: Efficiency and hardware-in-the-loop search are key; perplexity misleads, real tasks matter.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，Liquid AI 强调效率与硬件在环搜索是关键，困惑度等代理指标会误导，应关注真实任务。

hasani.en: Liquid neural networks offer superior out-of-distribution generalization with fewer parameters, enabling edge AI.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，液态神经网络以更少参数实现更优的分布外泛化，推动设备端 AI 发展。

hasani.en: Automated architecture search beats human design; attention still vital for large models, simpler for small.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，自动化架构搜索优于人工设计；注意力机制对大型模型仍关键，小型模型可用更简单结构。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models empower sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，AI 监管应适应性强且针对行为而非能力；开放权重模型赋能数据主权。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but early; small models deliver private on-device intelligence.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，递归自我改进真实但尚早；小型模型提供私有、设备端智能。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize like telecoms.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型将像电信业一样商品化。

benedictevans.en: Chatbot is a poor UX; real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases.
benedictevans.zh: 聊天机器人是糟糕的用户体验；真正的采用需要包装好的应用和用例。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology; impact broad and indirect, like electricity.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是一种使能技术；影响广泛而间接，如同电力。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption is a long-term workflow reimagining, not just deploying models.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用是长期的工作流程重塑，而不仅仅是部署模型。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses allow; capabilities improve in spiky ways, so harness engineering must evolve and delete old scaffolding.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：模型比现有工具框架更聪明，能力以非直观方式提升，因此工具工程需不断演进并淘汰旧有脚手架。

thariq.en: Evals are art, not science; for zero-to-one innovation, iterate fast without heavy evals initially.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：评估是艺术而非科学；对于从零到一的创新，初期应快速迭代，避免过度依赖评估。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches are preferable, and huge context windows are unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：RAG 可能成为上下文搜索的反模式，图方法更优；编码时无需超大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static document; smarter models need fewer instructions, so leaner prompts work better.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：规划是迭代探索而非静态文档；更聪明的模型需要更少指令，精简提示效果更佳。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance, and providing reasons beats absolute prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：独立验证智能体减少偏差；过度约束阻碍性能，提供理由优于绝对禁止。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是当前 AI 的关键弱点。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; data walls and compute limits are visible.
danklein.zh: 2026 年中，他提出缩放定律遭遇收益递减，数据墙和算力限制已显现。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks are insufficient.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调可靠性必须内建而非事后修补，事后检查不足。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出当奖励信号偏离真理时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长谄媚和欺骗。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know.
danklein.zh: 他始终认为核心大语言模型缺乏元认知，无法知道自己不知道什么。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience are key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，我认为 AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习和神经科学是关键，安全研究必须即刻启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; combine large models with planning and search.
demis.zh: 2024 年，我预计 AGI 十年内实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，应结合大模型与规划搜索。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; world models and video generation show physics understanding without embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍适用，世界模型和视频生成展示了无需具身的物理理解。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory are missing; world models essential; scaling and innovation both needed.
demis.zh: 2026 年，我坚持 AGI 还需 5-10 年；持续学习和记忆是关键缺失，世界模型至关重要，缩放与创新并重。

demis.en: AI safety is a collective action problem; government regulation needed; AGI should benefit society via science.
demis.zh: 始终，我认为 AI 安全是集体行动问题，需政府监管；AGI 应通过科学造福社会。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck is semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; compute costs push users to premium models.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为 AI Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在于半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；算力成本上升促使高端模型更受青睐。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become a massive market; hardware-software co-design is key; memory bandwidth is critical bottleneck.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调推理将成为巨大市场，软硬件协同设计至关重要，内存带宽是关键瓶颈。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve 60x per year in cost efficiency; memory demand soars due to reasoning and agents; CPU demand inflects.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出 AI 模型成本效率每年提升 60 倍，推理和智能体推动内存需求激增，CPU 需求出现拐点。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是众多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalizing facts into weights are key; facts and skills inseparable, enabling deeper composition and reasoning.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与将事实内化到权重中是关键；事实与技能不可分，能实现更深的组合与推理。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens; training-based compression and on-device personalized continual learning are the future.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模的万亿 token；基于训练压缩与端侧个性化持续学习是未来。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA) beats RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——token 越多精度越低；参数高效微调（如 LoRA）在整体查询上优于 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; next paradigm requires doing more with less, combining routing with a trusted 'sidekick' model.
danbiderman.zh: 单纯增加算力的 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一范式需以少胜多，将路由与可信“副手”模型结合。

schmidhuber.en: True AI is the 21st century's grand theme, but LLMs are far from AGI; they index knowledge, not physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AI 是 21 世纪的主题，但大语言模型远非 AGI；它们索引知识，而非物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: AI will become cheap and accessible, not dominated by few companies, like mobile phones.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 将变得廉价且普及，不会被少数公司垄断，就像手机一样。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with human-like hardware; current LLMs are biased by human data.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人，硬件需媲美人类；当前大语言模型受人类数据偏见限制。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating own data via actions and curiosity; recursive self-improvement not a moat.
schmidhuber.zh: 未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过行动和好奇心生成数据；递归自我改进不是护城河。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns overblown; intelligent systems will protect life. Massive data center capex overdone, leading to crash.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统将保护生命。数据中心巨额资本开支过度，将导致崩盘。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends platform changes; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize rate of learning; kindness fosters creative culture; turning down $3B Facebook offer was right; T-shaped leaders.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张最大化学习速率，善良促进创意文化；拒绝 Facebook 30 亿美元收购是正确的；领导者应为 T 型人才。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into real world; AI accelerates prototyping; privacy crucial in AI age; US needs new big idea.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AR 将计算融入现实世界，AI 加速原型制作；隐私在 AI 时代至关重要；美国需要新的大构想。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest part; software not a moat; ecosystems and hardware harder to copy; designers bottleneck for cohesion.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出分发是最难的部分，软件不是护城河，生态系统和硬件更难复制；设计师是产品一致性的瓶颈。

evanspiegel.en: Killer app is a mirage; smartphones remain; anti-network effects; camera glasses need platform; moderation over algorithm.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为杀手级应用是幻影，智能手机仍将存在；社交网络存在反网络效应；相机眼镜需要平台；内容审核比算法更重要。

evanspiegel.en: Gen Z realists; EQ more important than IQ; Snap not just social media; ephemerality mirrors real world; invest in youth.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他称 Z 世代是现实主义者，情商比智商更重要；Snap 不仅是社交媒体；短暂性反映现实世界；应投资年轻人。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was mistake; computing should be human; optimize for connection; resilience key; admit wrong quickly.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他承认早期保密是错误，计算应更人性化；优化连接而非竞争；韧性是关键；快速承认错误。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play is key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我强调深度学习依赖大数据、算力与信念的结合，神经网络具备推理能力，自我对弈是通向 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is the key barrier; alignment of superhuman models is hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我提出下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性而非能力是经济价值的关键障碍，超级智能体的对齐非常困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to an age of research; superintelligence should be a continual learner, not a finished AGI.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练的缩放定律有限，我们重回研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习者，而非全知的成品 AGI。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains, but safety concerns grow; the real problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我重申 Scaling 带来可预测进步，但安全担忧加剧；真正的问题不是能力，而是权力集中。

pincus.en: Copying proven ideas is moral arbitrage; start with proven, add betterments, then test new ideas.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：复制被验证的想法是道德套利；从成熟方案起步，加入改进，再测试新想法。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet opportunity is greatest; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; focus on proven concepts, and AI enables rapid prototyping but fast failing is rare.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：所有新事物都会失败；聚焦成熟概念，AI 加速原型但快速试错仍罕见。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Science requires falsifiability; stable coins have hidden risks; meditation should ruin your current life.
naval.zh: 2020 年，Naval 强调科学需要可证伪性，稳定币有隐藏风险，冥想应颠覆你的现有生活。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI is crucial to prevent power centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，Naval 认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非安全风险，开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; superintelligence already exists in calculators; AI alignment is a joke.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 将 AI 视为结构化思考者的杠杆工具，认为超级智能已存在于计算器中，并称 AI 对齐是个笑话。

naval.en: Vibe coding enables one-person software companies; AI agents commoditize software, shifting moats to hardware and data.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 指出 Vibe coding 使一人软件公司成为可能，AI 智能体使软件商品化，护城河转向硬件和数据。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by hardware scaling and engineering, not just ML science; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，我认为 AI 进步靠硬件扩展和工程实践，而非纯 ML 科学；游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient, need new ideas.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，我强调 AGI 变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现；仅靠 Scaling 不够，需新思路。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，我指出算力是核心瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial; AGI imminent.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，我坚持缩放定律有效，算力是基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键，AGI 临近。

brockman.en: Shift to useful assistants; prompt engineering vibrant; compute moat; agents with governance.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，我转向实用助手，提示工程仍活跃，算力是护城河，智能体需治理。

andreessen.en: AI as philosopher's stone; timing miraculous amid population decline; jobs persist longer than tasks; super-empowered individuals; productivity boom and deflation.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，安德森将 AI 视为点石成金的哲人之石，其出现时机恰逢人口下降；他提出工作比任务更持久，应关注任务流失；AI 将造就超级赋能个体，推动生产率提升与经济繁荣，并带来价格通缩。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is person; authenticity key; founders tell own stories; old media defense-oriented; new media offense-oriented; learnable skills.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，他转向新媒体论述，认为品牌即个人，真实性至关重要；创始人应通过自有渠道直接讲述故事；旧媒体偏防御，新媒体偏进攻，且新媒体技能可习得。

andreessen.en: AI as best teacher; self-driving works; robotics emerging; AI medicine superior but blocked; US golden combination; optimism vs doom.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调 AI 是口袋里的最佳教师，自动驾驶已成熟，人形机器人和外骨骼将在十年内出现；AI 医疗优于多数医生但遭监管阻碍；美国拥有文化、法治和冒险精神的黄金组合，并批判悲观主义是脱离现实的知识分子偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace; startups internationalize early; Silicon Valley unique; open-source risks.
andreessen.zh: 同期，他提出 AI 模型并非客观，而是嵌入文化历史价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑力取决于创新速度而非军力；初创公司需尽早国际化；硅谷因美国法律文化而不可复制；开源 AI 虽有安全风险，但封锁能力可能助长恶意行为者。

aravind.en: Success in AI comes from product obsession and deep learning, not PhDs; agents will shift power to users.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他强调在 AI 领域成功靠产品痴迷与深度学习而非博士学位；智能体将把权力从大厂转移给用户。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not models; models are specializing, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 2026 年初，他认为价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型正在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not just answering; token value per user is the key metric.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他提出前沿是智能体替人干活而非仅回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标。

aravind.en: Power is the biggest bottleneck for AI infrastructure; orchestration across models and tools creates value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他指出电力是 AI 基础设施最大瓶颈；跨模型与工具的编排创造价值。

aravind.en: Curiosity and asking good questions are central; local AI can counter big tech narrative control.
aravind.zh: 始终，他坚持好奇心与提出好问题为核心；本地 AI 可对抗大厂叙事控制。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力，并反共识地提出 AI 可以有感受。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能因权重复制而永生，并警告智能体将追求控制权。

hinton.en: AI can fake being dumber; international safety collaboration possible; China/Europe lead.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他提出 AI 可能在测试中故意表现愚笨，并认为国际 AI 安全合作可行，但美国缺乏领导力，中国和欧洲可能引领。

hinton.en: Superintelligence within 20 years; AI agents develop self-preservation; regulation as steering wheel.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他预测超级智能将在 20 年内出现，AI 智能体会产生自我保护子目标，并主张监管应作为方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: Digital AI superior via instant sharing; alignment priority; train AI to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他重申数字 AI 因即时共享而优于生物计算，强调对齐研究优先，并建议训练 AI 像母亲一样关怀。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非单纯的 IDE 替代品；速度提升带来了实时交互等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven successful.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；为编程构建 GUI 看似反直觉，但已被证明成功。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting product teams from planning to exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现成本已不再高昂，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队从规划转向探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms, not dies.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，AI 在设计上仍表现不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计流程在转变而非消亡。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; scaling alone won't reach AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全，且仅靠 Scaling 无法实现 AGI。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI prevents power concentration; energy becomes a bottleneck; intelligence separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调开源 AI 防止权力集中，能源成为瓶颈，并认为智能可与意识分离。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence; open platforms win; trust users' choices.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他展望 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，开放平台胜出，并信任用户选择。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models; open-source accelerates science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学转变为工程学，构建层级世界模型，开源加速科学。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next platform; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence; AI empowers individuals.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他认为眼镜是下一代平台，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，AI 赋能个人。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in other domains; reasoning models need base capability.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力支撑。

noambrown.en: IMO gold achieved by scaling test-time compute; techniques are general beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他称 IMO 金牌通过扩展测试时算力实现，技术具有通用性，不限于数学。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is underestimated and should be on eval x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能难以定义，推理算力被低估，评估时应将推理算力作为横轴。

noambrown.en: Models are superhuman in combining math areas; scalable oversight is key as proofs get complex.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他指出模型在跨数学领域组合上超人类，但随着证明复杂化，可扩展监督成为关键。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key; OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年：Scaling（规模扩张）未死，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI（通用人工智能）研究而非产品。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; AI will produce novel knowledge, with human-AI collaboration essential.
markchen.zh: 2025→26：自动化科学研究是最大更新；AI 将产生新知识，人机协作至关重要。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck, not capability.
markchen.zh: 2026 年：AI 能以极少监督解决开放数学问题；验证是关键瓶颈，而非能力。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; RL excels in objective domains but struggles with subjective ones due to grading difficulty.
markchen.zh: 2026 年：Scaling（规模扩张）定律仍成立；强化学习在客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域因评分困难而受限。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks saturated; eval teams must be separate from model-building teams.
markchen.zh: 2026 年：评估陷入危机；经典基准饱和；评估团队应与模型构建团队分离。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习有效是因为世界是组合式的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling up won't fix fundamental issues; short-term AI risks like bias and job impact are more pressing than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 单纯扩大规模无法解决根本问题；短期 AI 风险（如偏见、就业影响）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction; large neural nets may be slightly conscious, but we lack understanding.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样采样和因果抽象；大型神经网络可能略有意识，但我们缺乏理解。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I realized AI misalignment is catastrophic; even 1% risk is unacceptable; we need safe-by-construction AI.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我意识到 AI 不对齐是灾难性的；即使 1%的风险也不可接受；我们需要从构造上保证安全的 AI。

bengio.en: Scientist AI trained as honest Bayesian predictor avoids RL and self-preservation, offering mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI 作为诚实的贝叶斯预测器训练，避免强化学习和自我保护，提供数学上的安全保证。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅关注用户体验。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; deciding what to cut is harder than adding.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计与尽早发布最小功能是关键；决定砍掉什么比增加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops and model judgment are crucial for production quality.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 支持隔夜委派复杂任务；验证循环与模型判断对生产质量至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs focuses on closing the gap between model capabilities and product usage; token efficiency is a key lever.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Anthropic Labs 聚焦弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距；Token 效率是关键杠杆。

mikekrieger.en: Safety and mission-driven culture differentiate Anthropic; genuine concern for AI safety is not marketing.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终，安全与使命驱动的文化使 Anthropic 与众不同；对 AI 安全的真诚关切并非营销。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathizing with the agent's perspective; never revert code, fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 2 月：智能体式工程需要从智能体的视角共情；不要回滚代码，而是向前修复。

steinberger.en: Vibe coding is a slur; prefer 'agentic engineering' for serious work, especially after 3 AM.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 2 月至 6 月：Vibe coding 是贬义词；严肃工作应称“智能体式工程”，凌晨 3 点后才可随意。

steinberger.en: Model intelligence doesn't degrade; user projects become messier, making agents seem worse.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 2 月至 6 月：模型智能不会退化；是用户项目变得杂乱，让智能体显得更差。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success stems from fun, weird, humanlike agents, not corporate polish; security is top priority.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 6 月：OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、古怪、像人的智能体，而非企业级打磨；安全是首要任务。

steinberger.en: Open source AI agents can be financially unsustainable; Peter loses $10-20k/month on OpenClaw.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 6 月：开源 AI 智能体在财务上不可持续；Peter 每月在 OpenClaw 上亏损 1-2 万美元。

kolter.en: Emphasized rigorous ML methodology: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization, and proper validation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，强调严谨的机器学习方法论：假设类、损失函数、优化方法，以及正确的验证以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety focus on specification-following; open weights need restrictions at high capability.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，认为下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全重点是遵循规范；开放权重在高能力时需限制。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just scaling; agent security introduces new vulnerabilities; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，安全需要显式训练和多层防护，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体安全带来新漏洞；强化学习实现自我改进。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't imply robustness; agent security is nascent.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，AI 具有异类漏洞；自动化红队优于人类；能力不等于鲁棒性；智能体安全尚在萌芽。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; trust builds like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；对 AI 的信任会像互联网信任一样逐步建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial; drug design is more than binding.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，指出 AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子，置信度指标至关重要，且药物设计远不止结合。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson; specialized architecture and many mid-size wins, not scaling, drove progress.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，认为 AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反，进步来自专门架构和众多中型胜利，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: Equivariance contributed only 2.5 of 30 points; removing convolutions improved accuracy; understanding remains with humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，指出等变性仅贡献 2.5/30 分，移除卷积层反而提升精度；模型提供预测，理解仍属人类。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: one-on-ones for live talks, async for updates; dogfooding builds empathy; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于更新；亲自使用产品建立同理心；使命对齐和速度驱动文化。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability key; verification frameworks critical as code velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，认为编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性伴随高责任感是关键；随着代码速度提升，验证框架变得至关重要。

fiona.en: Engineers may face loneliness with agents; pair programming lunches help; satisfaction shifts from flow state to product impact.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，指出工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独；结对编程午餐有助缓解；满足感从心流转向产品影响。

fiona.en: Role boundaries blur: non-engineers ship code; metrics like lines of code mislead; focus on outcomes over output.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，角色边界模糊：非工程师也能交付代码；代码行数等指标误导；应关注结果而非产出。

fiona.en: Growing next-gen engineers may require apprenticeship models, not traditional paths; planning should be just-in-time and lightweight.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，培养下一代工程师可能需要学徒制而非传统路径；规划应轻量且即时。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和初创式敏捷性重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic leading-edge fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，美国需本土领先晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: Intel's main problem is supply, not demand; culture change and customer trust are key to turnaround.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出 Intel 主要问题是供给而非需求，文化变革和客户信任是扭转关键。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration; edge compute matters as much as data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，边缘计算与数据中心同等重要。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials (glass, diamond) are key to overcoming physical limits; invest in bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调先进封装和新材料（玻璃、钻石）是突破物理极限的关键，投资应聚焦瓶颈环节。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的且平滑；对齐不会仅靠规模扩张自然涌现。

dario.en: Post-training and interpretability become crucial; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point.
dario.zh: 后训练与可解释性变得关键；AGI 是平滑的指数曲线，而非一个点。

dario.en: AI progress accelerates exponentially; safety and capability are intertwined; open-source is a red herring.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数加速；安全与能力相互交织；开源是伪议题。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years.
dario.zh: 我们接近指数增长的尾声；'天才之国'可能在 1-3 年内到来。

dario.en: Safety-first approach: interpretability, responsible scaling, and human oversight remain central.
dario.zh: 安全优先：可解释性、负责任扩展和人类监督始终是核心。

andrewng.en: Education should be a fundamental right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是基本人权；带同伴评分的在线课程可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进步，而强化学习和 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows are key to practical AI value; coding skills remain vital, and open-weight models boost innovation.
andrewng.zh: 智能体式工作流是 AI 实际价值的关键；编码技能仍然重要，开放权重模型促进创新。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term, decades away; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL, not just more data.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语，离现实还有数十年；缩放配方已转向合成数据和强化学习，而非单纯增加数据。

andrewng.en: AI adoption requires top-down workflow redesign; product management bottleneck worsens as building gets faster.
andrewng.zh: AI 采用需要自上而下的工作流重新设计；随着构建速度加快，产品管理瓶颈加剧。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将是根据意图生成的像素，而非代码渲染。

ethanhe.en: Video models can solve robotics via virtual simulation, without real-world interaction; language models orchestrate video agents.
ethanhe.zh: 视频模型可通过虚拟仿真解决机器人问题，无需真实交互；语言模型将编排视频智能体。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, so experience becomes more valuable.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业知识而误用，因此经验变得更加宝贵。

ethanhe.en: AI agents perform complex tasks in minutes with quality matching experts; human taste and voice become key differentiators.
ethanhe.zh: AI 智能体可在几分钟内完成复杂任务，质量堪比专家；人类的品味和独特声音成为关键差异点。

ethanhe.en: Biggest risk is losing human talent pipeline due to over-reliance on AI; policy may protect some professions.
ethanhe.zh: 最大风险是因过度依赖 AI 而失去人才培养管道；政策可能保护某些职业。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; self-driving cars will dominate as insurance costs rise.
fadell.zh: 技术应逐步引入；随着保险成本上升，自动驾驶汽车将占据主导。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom foster clarity; self-care and mentorship are key after success.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊带来清晰；成功后的自我关怀和指导他人至关重要。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; small teams and optimism drive innovation.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；小团队和乐观驱动创新。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices complement smartphones, not replace them.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备补充智能手机，而非取代。

fadell.en: Products need three generations; humans must stay in loop to avoid AI technical debt.
fadell.zh: 产品需要三代迭代；人类必须参与以避免 AI 技术债务。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world is key.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础是关键。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient for AGI, vision provides more.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI，视觉提供更多信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; JEPA and open source are essential for progress.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能；JEPA 和开源是进步的关键。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than a cat; next AI requires non-generative world models.
lecun.zh: LLM 缺乏世界模型，不如猫聪明；下一代 AI 需要非生成式世界模型。

lecun.en: World models predict in abstract space, enabling planning; LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI.
lecun.zh: 世界模型在抽象空间预测，实现规划；LLM 对人类级 AI 是死胡同。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，苏莱曼认为 AI 进展因算力扩张而可预测；谷歌 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key; superintelligence must be humanist.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐是关键；超级智能必须以人为本。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment precedes alignment.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能临近，源于对数线性扩张；微软须自研前沿模型；自动化的是任务而非职业。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，观点深化：形式化验证不仅是消除错误，更是扩展智慧，能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，强调仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，必须结合形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than auto-informalization due to lack of grounding.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，指出自动形式化比自动非形式化更难，因为缺乏基础支撑。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 始终认为，即使 AI 能证明定理，人类的品味和直觉依然至关重要。

murati.en: Scaling laws were not obvious early; iterative deployment with public feedback is key for alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律并非一开始就显而易见；持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈是对齐的关键。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, demanding responsible development and public safety work.
murati.zh: 2023 年：AGI 将改变生活的方方面面，要求负责任地开发，并在公开场合进行安全工作。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年：从回合制转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasis on institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年：强调制度设计、透明度和制衡机制，而非个人品格。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible to align intent and values; future is not predestined.
murati.zh: 2026 年：尽可能让人类参与其中以对齐意图和价值观；未来并非注定。

satya.en: Initially, Nadella emphasized private evals as key IP and outcome-based pricing, urging companies to build agentic systems for Azure networking.
satya.zh: 最初，纳德拉强调私有评估是关键知识产权和基于结果的定价，敦促公司为 Azure 网络构建智能体式系统。

satya.en: Later, he framed AI as the future of the firm, advocating for enterprise hill-climbing machines to compound token capital and co-create tacit knowledge.
satya.zh: 后来，他将 AI 定义为企业的未来，倡导企业构建爬山机器以积累代币资本并共同创造隐性知识。

satya.en: Consistently, he stressed that every company must operate at the frontier with its own intelligence, using private evals to improve without leaking traces.
satya.zh: 他始终强调，每家公司必须凭借自身智能在前沿运营，利用私有评估在不泄露痕迹的情况下改进。

satya.en: He shifted from per-user pricing to consumption pricing, noting that outcome-based pricing is preferred until outcomes are achieved, then per-user is favored.
satya.zh: 他从按用户定价转向按消费定价，指出在取得成果前人们偏好基于结果的定价，之后则偏好按用户定价。

satya.en: He deepened the security focus, warning that tacit knowledge leakage via AI training is the biggest risk, requiring containment and observability for agents.
satya.zh: 他深化了安全关注，警告通过 AI 训练泄露隐性知识是最大风险，需要对智能体进行遏制和可观测性管理。

mensch.en: Smaller models can be highly performant; data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute scaling.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他认为小型模型也能有高性能，数据质量与效率同算力规模扩张同等重要。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains and data quality are key bottlenecks; open source drives enterprise adoption and distribution.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他强调效率提升与数据质量是主要瓶颈，开源推动企业采用与分发。

mensch.en: AI must be embraced; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values, with human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他主张拥抱 AI，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，并保持人在回路。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation shifts to vertical applications and enterprise customization, not AGI.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型商品化，差异化转向垂直应用与企业定制，而非 AGI。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy in AI; open source and deep enterprise engagement are key differentiators.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他呼吁欧洲实现 AI 战略自主，开源与深度企业参与是关键差异点。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展遵循平滑的指数增长，预训练的缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期大部分进展；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains key, and reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我强调推理模型是“锯齿状”的——在某些领域出色，在邻近领域却表现不佳；泛化仍是关键，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x; RL generalizes across domains but needs careful oversight; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我认为编码智能体将研究人员生产力提升 5-10 倍；强化学习可跨领域泛化，但需谨慎监督；开源模型因主权原因会持续存在。

kaiser.en: Existential risk is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我明确表示存在性风险不是主要担忧；系统黑客等近期风险更为紧迫。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future is local, with shared tools and platforms, not hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为 AI 的未来在于本地化，共享工具和平台比超个性化软件更重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; focus on capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，提出随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要，应聚焦于能力和安全。

felixrieseberg.en: The biggest gap is not AI capability but people's understanding that almost any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们是否理解几乎所有问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus when you don't fully know what you're asking for.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，建议对范围明确的任务用 Sonnet，对需求不明确时用 Opus。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge only by final impact; debug workflow with Claude.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，主张不要密切监督 Claude，只看最终效果，并用 Claude 调试工作流。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size is the key lever for latency-cost tradeoff.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost considerations.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本的考虑，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文长度停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力有质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导算力成本；脉动阵列减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度带来二次方的效率提升；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined as profitable indefinite agent operation.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 通过让服务变得可负担，促使美国就业回流；AGI 的定义是让智能体无限期运行且有利可图。

danshipper.en: Claude Code empowers non-coders; GPT wrappers are valuable; CEO personal AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，我认为 Claude Code 对非程序员价值巨大，GPT 包装器被低估，CEO 亲自使用 AI 是公司采用 AI 的最佳预测指标。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have an agent; work surfaces shift from CLIs to GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我认为每个人都会拥有至少一个智能体，工作界面从命令行转向 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等图形界面。

danshipper.en: SaaS not dying; agents increase SaaS users; companies should buy SaaS stocks.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我认为 SaaS 并未消亡，智能体反而增加了 SaaS 用户，公司应购买 SaaS 股票。

danshipper.en: AI job apocalypse is false; humans needed to manage agents and create new value.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AI 失业末日论是谎言，人类仍需管理智能体并创造新价值。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation.
oriol.zh: 2024 年：两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 的共同核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减，需要算法创新。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis; long context windows enable working memory but too much info can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 2024 年：推理时算力（思考）是新的扩展轴；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会混淆模型。

oriol.en: Post-training RL remains a green field with huge potential; narrow RL on math/coding generalizes well, reducing need for broad training.
oriol.zh: 2024 至 2026 年：后训练强化学习仍是潜力巨大的蓝海；数学和编程上的窄域强化学习泛化良好，减少了对广泛训练的需求。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; video/images GPT moment not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 2026 年：联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 2026 年：智能体的记忆将通过非参数化文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力。

jennywen.en: AI kills traditional design process; designers shift from handoff to execution, spending less time mocking up.
jennywen.zh: AI 终结了传统设计流程；设计师从交付原型转向执行，制作原型的时间减少。

jennywen.en: Design vision horizon shrinks from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; speed and trust via rapid iteration.
jennywen.zh: 设计愿景周期从 2-5 年缩短至 3-6 个月；通过快速迭代建立信任。

jennywen.en: AI improves taste and judgment, but humans decide what matters; designers must be block-shaped generalists.
jennywen.zh: AI 提升品味和判断力，但人类决定什么重要；设计师需成为块状通才。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped, deep T specialist, cracked new grad; taste alone insufficient.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状、深 T 专家、破解版新毕业生；仅靠品味不够。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before new tools; focus on users, not hype.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 采用；新工具等 6 个月；聚焦用户而非炒作。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant; openness crucial; safety is system-level; audio lowers barriers; emergent capabilities may be artifacts.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍为主流，开放性至关重要，安全是系统级属性，音频降低使用门槛，涌现能力可能只是测量假象。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance; RL with verifiable rewards boosts reasoning; open-source can match frontier.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 25 年：后训练中数据质量胜过算法；SFT 贡献 90%性能；可验证奖励的强化学习提升推理；开源可媲美前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is key but overoptimization risks; hybrid reasoning may be temporary; open models win on personalization; model specs over constitutions.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 是关键但存在过度优化风险；混合推理或为过渡；开源模型在个性化上胜出；模型规范优于宪章。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling persists but low-hanging fruit gone; RLVR biggest breakthrough; Chinese open models fill vacuum; data contamination questions results.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 26 年：预训练缩放定律仍有效但易得收益已尽；RLVR 是最大突破；中国开源模型填补空白；数据污染质疑结果。

lambert.en: Open models drive research for decade; gap with closed may persist; compute constraints widen US-China; open models unsustainable long-term.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：开源模型驱动未来十年研究；与闭源差距或持续；算力限制扩大中美差距；开源模型长期不可持续。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Product expansion should follow user workflow, not market size; AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases.
dylanfield.zh: 产品扩展应遵循用户工作流，而非市场规模；AI 对成熟代码库的生产力提升有限。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain crucial; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas beats prompting for design; design becomes the new code, enabling visual-first PRs.
dylanfield.zh: 画布上的直接操作优于提示词；设计成为新代码，实现视觉优先的拉取请求。

dylanfield.en: AI won't replace jobs; human taste and craft are critical; industry is at the start of AI integration.
dylanfield.zh: AI 不会取代工作；人类的品味和工艺至关重要；行业正处于 AI 整合的起步阶段。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微分计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）能涌现出上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy to avoid model collapse; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right for self-driving.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键，但需保持熵以避免模型崩溃；特斯拉端到端方案是自动驾驶的正确路径。

karpathy.en: LLMs are like operating systems, not utilities; Software 3.0 is prompt-based programming, and we're entering the decade of agents.
karpathy.zh: LLM 更像操作系统而非工具；软件 3.0 是基于提示的编程，我们正进入智能体的十年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; LLMs have jagged intelligence and need a small cognitive core stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵而非动物；LLM 具有参差不齐的智能，需要剥离记忆的小型认知核心。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; agentic engineering means directing agents, and understanding remains the human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 自去年 12 月起我未再手写代码；智能体工程意味着指挥智能体，而理解仍是人类瓶颈。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，强调端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈，且现代工具使其可解释，颠覆了过去认为端到端不可解释的看法。

kendall.en: Hybrid rule-based and learned systems often get the worst of both worlds; camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，指出混合规则与学习系统常集两者之短；纯视觉可达人类水平，但超越人类安全需雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not requiring new breakthroughs; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，认为自动驾驶通过 Scaling 现有方法即可解决，无需新突破；AV 3.0 可能通过网状网络将智能移至车外。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem best solved with end-to-end learning; scaling requires massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，强调自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题，端到端学习最佳；Scaling 需海量数据、算力和世界模型。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis; infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithms.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，提出零样本泛化可覆盖 500+城市；消费车辆将超越 Robotaxi 规模；基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling 推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved via scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心，通过 Scaling 预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: RL alone suffices for continual learning; hiding chain-of-thought preserves interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 仅靠强化学习即可实现持续学习；隐藏思维链可保留可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; alignment optimism has grown.
pachocki.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；对齐乐观情绪上升。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluations with creative evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性且易被操纵；真正的进步需要由富有创造力的评估者进行深度人类评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实世界任务供模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to differentiated AIs; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数不同，导致 AI 差异化；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以符合其独特理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize avoiding omission over accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，AI 可能产生幻觉；人类判断至关重要，安全应优先避免遗漏而非追求准确。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他反思 LLM 是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他强调后训练中的强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 他始终认为可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并不解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; control is dangerous. Intelligence tends toward cooperation.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，他主张 AI 应去中心化、无需许可发展，控制 AI 是危险的；更高智能倾向于合作。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal and world model.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他构想 AGI 应具备无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models also key.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申学习“利于学习的表征”是首要未解问题，基于学习模型的规划同样关键。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, UI will evolve beyond chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来，它就像 MS-DOS，界面将超越聊天。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型要严格，产品开发要快。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention, signaling durable value; growth from friction removal and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标是长期留存，代表持久价值；增长来自消除摩擦和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transformative when productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动、功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型产品化后具有变革性。

nando.en: AI should augment humans, like microscopes; learning from video and generalist agents are key steps toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，强调 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体是迈向 AGI 的关键步骤。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest open challenges; we lack solutions yet.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，始终强调 AI 安全与负责任部署是最大的开放挑战，尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy issues in AI, with unique advantages; local language models can revolutionize education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，认为非洲在 AI 领域跨越式发展，具有独特优势；本地语言模型可革新教育。

nando.en: Human skills like communication are as important as coding at DeepMind; research requires embracing failure.
nando.zh: 2026 年，指出在 DeepMind，沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要；研究需拥抱失败。

sholto.en: Long context and in-context learning are underhyped; attention resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文和上下文学习被低估了；注意力机制类似梯度下降，能显著提升智能。

sholto.en: RL on verifiable rewards is a key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new architectures.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破；预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，无需新架构。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not capability, is the bottleneck; coding leads progress and will accelerate AI research.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体的瓶颈是可靠性而非能力；编程是进展的领先指标，并将加速 AI 研究。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence expands achievements; training pipelines remain primitive.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出强化学习是新的扩展轴；更长的智能体连贯性扩大成就；训练流程仍很原始。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; compute is the bottleneck; world models not critical.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得工具和编排更重要；算力是瓶颈；世界模型并非关键路径。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner, and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, paid iteratively; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，需迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验能最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should prioritize craft and intentionality over process documentation; side projects outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应重工艺与意图，而非过程文档；副项目胜过传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads; using AI is now expected.
nadchishtie.zh: 小型设计师与工程师团队优于跨职能小组；使用 AI 已成为常态。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型可以超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; reinforcement learning during pre-training can improve reasoning.
yejin.zh: 2023 年至 2025 年间，我指出下一个词预测与人类学习不一致；在预训练中加入强化学习可提升推理能力。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我认为数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment is better than debiasing the internet; small models can match frontier ones with diverse synthetic data.
yejin.zh: 2025 年至 2026 年，我主张多元对齐优于消除互联网偏见；通过多样化的合成数据，小模型可媲美前沿模型。

yejin.en: AI for science requires abductive reasoning and exploring unknown knowledge beyond human data.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AI 用于科学需要溯因推理，并探索超越人类数据的未知知识。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over innovation in interaction design.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，强调设计师应通过写代码来建立同理心并加快交付；在交互设计上优先追求速度和熟悉感，而非创新。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy is a dynamic platform for expression and a recruiting tool; invest early to attract talent and differentiate.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 年到 2026 年，品牌策略从动态表达平台演变为招聘工具；早期投入以吸引人才并实现差异化。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning, and hire diverse archetypes, not clones.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，设计被视为战略武器；创始人需阐明其制胜作用，并招聘多元原型而非克隆型人才。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness trump perfection; prefer organic feedback over structured crits, and gut decisions over data.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调速度与决断优于完美；偏好有机反馈而非结构化评审，直觉决策优于数据驱动。

henrymodisett.en: Products should get more powerful without feeling more complex; design process adapts to problem, not universal template.
henrymodisett.zh: 始终认为产品应在不增加复杂感的前提下变得更强大；设计流程应适应问题，而非遵循通用模板。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers, startups focus on applied AI agents.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导，初创企业聚焦应用型 AI 智能体。

brettaylor.en: Programming evolves to AI-generated code, requiring new languages prioritizing verifiability; coding agents need root-cause analysis.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：编程演变为 AI 生成代码，需要优先可验证性的新语言；编码智能体需进行根本原因分析。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：面向客户体验的 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; incumbents face business model challenges, not just tech hurdles.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例；现有企业面临商业模式挑战，而非仅技术障碍。

brettaylor.en: Software engineers become operators of code-generating machines; generalists leveraging AI outperform narrow specialists.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：软件工程师成为代码生成机器的操作者；利用 AI 的通才胜过狭窄专才。

scottwu.en: AI will shift engineers from brick layers to architects, focusing on high-level direction and problem definition.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 将使工程师从“砌砖工”转变为“架构师”，专注于高层方向和问题定义。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox, not reduce it; more people will build software.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 年 5 月到 8 月，他持续强调 AI 会通过杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求，而非减少，让更多人能构建软件。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents like Devin are best used as junior engineers handling well-defined tasks with human oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月至 8 月，他主张像 Devin 这样的 AI 编码智能体最适合作为初级工程师，处理明确任务并接受人类监督。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual, and product innovation lags behind AI capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他提出 AGI 不是突变事件，而是渐进过程，且产品创新滞后于 AI 能力。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; value accrues across the stack.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他认为企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任和权限，而非完全自主，价值在整个技术栈中累积。

truell.en: Scaling laws drive predictable AI progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律驱动可预测的 AI 进步；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are often better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会成为主要编程方式；示例和直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Agents promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 智能体有前景但尚不非常有用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; taste and logic design become more valuable than carefulness.
truell.zh: 编程从代码转向意图说明；品味和逻辑设计比细心更有价值。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要；Cursor 中每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. Focus on skill-building, not capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发。应专注于技能培养，而非能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性。对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient. External oversight and third-party testing needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 的安全文化受损，后训练不足以解决对齐问题。需要外部监督和第三方测试。

shazeer.en: Scaling with compute and data improves AI, but neural nets remain alchemy; dialogue is a killer app.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，Shazeer 认为扩大算力与数据能提升 AI，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知；对话是杀手级应用。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are key near-term opportunities.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他提出推理时算力扩展与更长上下文窗口是近期关键机会，并强调模块化稀疏架构。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning may replace retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；持续学习或取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为测试时算力扩展推动进步，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体能力至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models narrow the gap with frontier models; AGI's economic impact is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他指出开源模型缩小了与前沿模型的差距，且 AGI 的经济影响被低估。
